posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha is glowing as fans spot a baby bump at her 'Maa Inti Bangaaram' success bash; reports say she and director-husband Raj Nidimoru are expecting their first child in December 2026.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika is expecting her second child even as she's set to become the first Indian citizen with a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame; she's also joined Allu Arjun's mega sci-fi 'Raaka'.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK unveils the first look of 'King', locked for Christmas 2026 — the ₹350-crore actioner marks daughter Suhana Khan's big-screen debut alongside him.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer is on a victory lap as 'Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge' storms past ₹1,780 crore worldwide and lands the biggest-ever OTT debut on JioHotstar with 70M+ views.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha stuns in a never-before-seen avatar as the 'Eetha' teaser — playing legendary Tamasha artist Vithabai Narayangaonkar — drops with 'Cocktail 2'; the film locks August 28, 2026.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun's ambitious sci-fi epic with Atlee gets its fierce first-look title 'Raaka'; the ₹600-crore parallel-universe spectacle has begun filming with Deepika Padukone and Janhvi Kapoor.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Thalapathy Vijay turns kingmaker — his TVK sweeps 108 seats to become Tamil Nadu's single-largest party, supercharging buzz for his final film 'Jana Nayagan'.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia goes full assassin as the 'Alpha' trailer launches YRF's Spy Universe's first female-led film; she plays 'Sita' opposite Sharvari, releasing July 3.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara embraces her 'mom era', sharing tender glimpses of baby Saraayah on a family getaway with Sidharth Malhotra, as she gears up for 'Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups'.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit makes history as LA City Council declares a 'Diljit Dosanjh Day', while 'Main Vaapas Aaunga' pulls off a remarkable second-week box-office turnaround.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka confirms a dream collaboration with Angelina Jolie and gears up for SS Rajamouli's globe-trotting 'Varanasi', slated for April 2027.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika charms audiences as 'Diya Reddy' in the newly released 'Cocktail 2', shares playful BTS, and reunites with Vijay Deverakonda for 'Rana Baali'.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR sports a lean, chiselled new avatar for Prashanth Neel's 'Dragon' — now eyeing a 2027 release — while reaffirming a packed slate with 'Devara 2' and 'War 2'.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi is having a landmark year — 'Homebound' is India's official Oscar entry, 'Peddi' with Ram Charan is in the works, and she joins the festive 'Sunny Sanskari Ki Tulsi Kumari'.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's pan-India sports drama 'Peddi', made on a staggering ₹350-crore budget with AR Rahman's music, is one of the year's most anticipated Telugu releases.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Bebo's gritty thriller 'Daayra' with Prithviraj Sukumaran, directed by Meghna Gulzar, locks a September 18, 2026 release.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: The maestro makes his Arabic-cinema debut with the haunting 'Baab' soundtrack while bringing his immersive 'Wonderment Tour' to stages across North America and beyond.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya's musical romance 'Chand Mera Dil' with Lakshya hits cinemas, and she's set to reprise her role in 'Call Me Bae' season two opposite Shruti Haasan.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya closes the 79th Cannes Film Festival in dramatic all-white couture — her 24th appearance — drawing both acclaim and the spotlight, with daughter Aaradhya by her side.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun rides a hot streak — patriotic war epic 'Border 2' crosses ₹464 crore — with his 'Ghar Kab Aaoge' track a chartbuster after the 'Bijuria' craze.

posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina is set to headline Ali Abbas Zafar's superhero film, and her Kay Beauty just launched the Cashmere Lip Blur range with Saba Azad.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik basks in praise after his electric face-off with Jr NTR in YRF's Spy Universe blockbuster 'War 2', calling the film the peak of everything he's done.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya takes her music global with 'The Unstoppable Tour' across Australia and New Zealand, and drops her soulful new devotional single 'Siddha Bhajo'.
